# `aube access list packages`

- **Usage:** `aube access list packages [ENTITY]`
- **Effect:** read-only

List packages visible to the current user or an optional entity.

## Arguments
- **`[ENTITY]`** — User, `@organization`, or `@scope:team`.

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
